title: Analog Clock
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Analog
learningObjectives: Calculate the angle of a clock hand by mapping a 0-59 second or minute value onto the range 0 to 2*pi radians
Apply sine and cosine to convert a hand's angle into the x and y screen coordinates of its tip
Explain why subtracting HALF_PI from the mapped angle rotates the twelve o'clock position to the top of the face
Compare manual mode, where hour, minute, and second sliders set the time, with automatic mode driven by the system clock
Distinguish the differing angular rates of the hour, minute, and second hands
